title: Mr. Sang Chui Choi, et al vs. Korean Central Presbytery
disposition_detail: Administratively out of order; the Assembly listed 2010-07 among seven cases (2009-29, 2009-30, 2009-31, 2010-06, 2010-07, 2010-17, 2010-25) found administratively out of order. No merits ruling or reasoned explanation appears in the adopted record.
first_summary: Mr. Sang Chui Choi and others brought a case against Korean Central Presbytery. The Standing Judicial Commission, at the 39th General Assembly (2011), found 2010-07 administratively out of order, listing it with six other 2009-2010 cases. No separate merits opinion was published, and the record supplies no reason for the ruling.
